column1: # One clue per answer, written once and reused by every grid that needs the
# word. A puzzle is the grid; the clues are this table. Answers are the only
# vocabulary the generator may use, so every generated puzzle is clued by
# construction and nothing ships with a blank clue.
# A clue is a plain definition in British spelling that points at one answer
# of its length, with nothing in it that could go out of date. It never
# contains its own answer, and never uses a double quote, so it can be
# written into Rust as it stands.
